parameters.formDescription: Paste the link to the quotation Google Sheet. Run it again after the QU number comes back from Xero — it updates the same record instead of making a new one.
parameters.formTitle: Sync a quotation to the tracker

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ requests: [ { addSheet: { properties: { title: $('Parse Request').first().json.config.syncTab, hidden: true } } } ] }) }}
